notes.title: bug fixes - 1
notes.content:
Bug Fix Update 🐜✨
Hello, Queen Defenders! 👑

We have a new update for Ant Protect the Queen focused on fixing some important bugs. Check out the main improvements:

🔹 Level 15 Bug (Easy Mode)
We fixed the issue that caused the game to crash when reaching level 15 in easy mode. Now you can continue protecting the Queen without interruptions!

🔹 Death of the Queen
Fixed the bug that caused the game to crash unexpectedly when the Queen died while the jumping ant was present.

We continue working to improve the game and we appreciate your feedback! If you encounter any more issues or have suggestions, don't hesitate to let us know!
